# `model_access`

Enforces model access control by checking the `model` field in the JSON request body against configured rules.

## Configuration Notes

Reads the user's group from `filter_metadata` (set by upstream auth filters like `api_key_auth` or `jwt_auth`) to apply per-group overrides.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `mode` | `allowlist` \| `denylist` | yes | Default access mode applied when no group override matches. |
| `models` | string[] | yes | Default model patterns. Supports trailing `*` for prefix matching. |
| `overrides` | GroupOverride[] | no | Per-group overrides. Checked in order; first matching group wins. |
| `overrides[].groups` | string[] | yes | Groups this override applies to. |
| `overrides[].mode` | `allowlist` \| `denylist` | yes | Access mode for these groups. |
| `overrides[].models` | string[] | yes | Model patterns for these groups. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum request body bytes to buffer for model extraction. |
| `group_metadata_key` | string | no | Metadata key for user's group (set by `api_key_auth` or `jwt_auth`). |

## Example

```yaml
filter: model_access
mode: denylist
models:
  - "claude-fable-*"
  - "o3-pro"
overrides:
  - groups: ["ai-eng", "executive"]
    mode: allowlist
    models: ["*"]
group_metadata_key: "x-tenant-group"
max_body_bytes: 65536
```
